name: Gasthof Lanzenhof
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Gasthof Lanzenhof in Going am Wilden Kaiser**

Nestled in the heart of **Tirol**, **Gasthof Lanzenhof** invites you to experience authentic alpine hospitality in the picturesque village of **Going am Wilden Kaiser**. Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, this charming guesthouse offers a warm retreat surrounded by breathtaking mountain scenery.

Indulge in hearty **Tiroler** cuisine, from freshly baked bread and creamy **Kaiserschmarrn** to savory **Käsespätzle** and tender **Wildschweinbraten**. Every dish is crafted with local ingredients, ensuring a true taste of the region.

After a day of hiking in the **Wilden Kaiser** or exploring the **Kaisergebirge**, unwind in our cozy common room with a glass of crisp **Tiroler** beer or a glass of fine wine. The friendly atmosphere and personal service make **Gasthof Lanzenhof** the perfect home away from home.

Whether you're seeking adventure or relaxation, **Gasthof Lanzenhof** promises an unforgettable stay in the stunning landscapes of **Tirol**.
